                                                           WU ZHIXIANG
                                                           吳志祥
                                                               Co-Chairman of the Board and Executive Director
                                                               董事會聯席董事長兼執行董事




I am pleased to present our first annual report for the year ended December 31,                  本人欣然向各位股東提呈我們作為公眾上市公司
2018 as a publicly listed company to our shareholders.                                           截至二零一八年十二月三十一日止年度的首份年
                                                                                                 度報告。


BUSINESS REVIEW AND OUTLOOK                                                                      業務回顧與展望
2018 was a remarkable year for the Company. We successfully completed the                        二零一八年對本公司而言是卓爾不凡的一年。我
merger of Tongcheng and eLong and achieved solid growth and profitability as                     們成功完成同程與藝龍合併，合併業務取得大幅
a combined business. We listed our Shares on the Main Board of the Hong Kong                     的增長及盈利。我們的股份於二零一八年十一月
Stock Exchange on November 26, 2018. Through the public listing, we have built                   二十六日在香港聯交所主板上市。透過公開上
our name in the capital market as an industry innovator, a market leader as well                 市，我們以在線旅行平台的行業革新者、市場領
as a pioneer in the OTA industry. As we continue to focus on user reach, product                 導者及行業先行者姿態馳名於資本市場。由於我
innovation and user experience, we have achieved strong business growth in                       們持續專注於用戶觸達、產品創新及用戶體驗，
2018 and continued our momentum, which we believe makes us one of the                            我們於二零一八年獲得強勁的業務增長並繼續保
fastest growing companies in China’s online travel industry.                                     持發展勢頭，我們相信我們已成為中國在線旅遊
                                                                                                 行業增長最快的公司之一。


2018 Results Highlights on a Combined Basis                                                      合併二零一八年業績摘要
Our total revenues increased by 16.5% from RMB5,226.1 million in 2017 to                         總收入由二零一七年的人民幣 5,226.1 百萬元增長
RMB6,090.8 million in 2018. Our adjusted profit for the year increased by 66.8%                  16.5% 至二零一八年的人民幣 6,090.8 百萬元。年
from RMB684.0 million in 2017 to RMB1,140.7 million in 2018. Our adjusted net                    內經調整溢利由二零一七年的人民幣 684.0 百萬
